cases.name: Zaniya Ann Wright
cases.about: She was a 7th grader at Illing Middle School. Her obituary said, "Some of her favorite hobbies were arts and crafts, drawing, painting, nature walks and going on thrilling amusement rides. Zaniya loved all things fashion and beauty-related. She took gymnastics and was looking forward to becoming a cheerleader."
cases.narrative: On 6/18/2021, her body was found in a common area of the basement of the South Adams Apartments at 40 Olcott St. after she was reported missing the night before.
